package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {var merge func(map[string]any,map[string]any)map[string]any;merge=func(a,b map[string]any)map[string]any{out:=map[string]any{};for k,v:=range a{out[k]=v};for k,v:=range b{if v==nil{delete(out,k)}else if obj,ok:=v.(map[string]any);ok{old,_:=out[k].(map[string]any);out[k]=merge(old,obj)}else{out[k]=v}};return out};out:=map[string]any{};for _,v:=range x["layers"].([]any){out=merge(out,v.(map[string]any))};return out}
